versions.changelog:
currency-forecast-pro 1.0.0

- Initial release of a professional currency exchange rate analysis and forecasting tool.
- Supports all major currency pairs with real-time data via Frankfurter API.
- Provides technical analysis: moving averages, trend, support/resistance, volatility.
- Forecasts with confidence intervals for 7-day and 30-day outlooks.
- Real-time market context from web research and economic news.
- No external dependencies required.
